verdict.rationale: Bench is a human-plus-software bookkeeping SaaS with a client web app, so asking whether its API matches the UI is a fair question. However, none of the evidence documents any public API for customers. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404, and every documented interaction is UI-, app- or human-mediated (in-app messaging, report downloads, Plaid account connections).
